title: Notification Regarding Interview for Placement Under Career Advancement Scheme - 2025
text:
KEY LINES:
No. APPSC-12/1/2024 Dated Itanagar, the 25 th April, 2025
In continuation of Commission's Notification No.APPSC-12/1/2024 Dated I I th
Memo No. APPSC-12/1/2024

FULL TEXT:
ARUNACHALPRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No. APPSC-12/1/2024 Dated Itanagar, the 25 th April, 2025
NOTIFICATION
In continuation of Commission's Notification No.APPSC-12/1/2024 Dated I I th
April, 2025, this is to inform all the candidates that the result of interview for placement of
Assistant Professors, Govt. Colleges of Arunachal Pradesh from Stage-3 to Stage-4 and
Placement of Lecturer, Govt. Polytechnic from Selection Grade-I to Grade-II under Career
Advancement Scheme (CAS) held on 24th and 25 th April, 2025 has been kept in abeyance as
necessary clarifications has been sought from the Department of Education, Government of
Arunachal Pradesh. The result will be notified after the clarification is received by the
Commission.
Memo No. APPSC-12/1/2024
Copy to: -
I. The PS to Hon'ble Chairman, APPSC.
